kebab_example: aliyun agentloop create-pipeline --agent-space my-agent-space --pipeline-name my-pipeline --description '从_SLS_采集_Trace_数据清洗入_Dataset' --pipeline '{"nodes":[{"id":"node-1","type":"transform","parameters":{"key":"example-string"}}]}' --source '{"inputFields":[{"name":"question","type":"text"}],"type":"SLS","logstore":{"query":"0_SELECT_0","project":"my-sls-project","logstore":"my-sls-logstore"},"dataset":{"filter":"status_=_pending","dataset":"my-dataset"}}' --sink '{"condition":{"defaultSink":{"type":"dataset","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"other-result"}},"routes":[{"expression":"0_where_intent_=_refund","sink":{"type":"dataset","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"refund-result"}},"id":"refund"}],"matchMode":"all"},"type":"Dataset","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"my-dataset"}}' --execute-policy '{"mode":"RunOnce","scheduled":{"fromTime":1735660800000,"interval":"1h"},"runOnce":{"fromTime":1735660800,"toTime":1735747200}}' --client-token a1b2c3d4-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipeline

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace under which the pipeline is created
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，流水线将创建在该 AgentSpace 下
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.example: 从 SLS 采集 Trace 数据清洗入 Dataset
parameters.help_en: The pipeline description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 流水线描述，最长 256 个字符
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The scheduling mode. Valid values:
RunOnce: one-time execution.
Scheduled: periodic scheduling
fields.help_zh: 调度模式：RunOnce（单次执行）或 Scheduled（周期调度）
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The start time of the data processing window, in UNIX seconds. The value must be less than toTime
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口起始时间，Unix 秒，必须小于 toTime
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The end time of the data processing window, in UNIX seconds. The value must be greater than fromTime
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口结束时间，Unix 秒，必须大于 fromTime
fields.name: to_time

fields.help_en: The one-time execution configuration. This parameter is required only when mode is set to RunOnce
fields.help_zh: 单次执行配置，仅 mode 为 RunOnce 时必填
fields.name: run_once

fields.help_en: The scheduling start time, in UNIX milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 调度起始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The scheduling interval. Valid values: 1h, 6h, 12h, and 1d
fields.help_zh: 调度间隔，支持 1h / 6h / 12h / 1d
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The periodic scheduling configuration. This parameter is required only when mode is set to Scheduled
fields.help_zh: 周期调度配置，仅 mode 为 Scheduled 时必填
fields.name: scheduled
